description:
Foldable Design
It takes very little time to compress the bike to theright size Easy to take with you to your apartmentor put in the trunk of your car.

Shimano 7-Speed
Provide more speed options for your riding, so you can easily ride on any terrain.Helps you get ready for your fitness warm-up ahead of time.

LCD DISPLAY
Bike speed, total mileage at a glance through the meter with 8-second cruise control and assisted push mode.

20''X4.0 Fat Tires
You can easily ride on snow, beach, mountain, and bumpy roads, and the service life of the tires can reach at least 2 years.

Sensitive Dual Disc Brakes
Whether it is raining or sunny, it can respond quickly and travel without worry.It can provide braking in a short distance to ensure the safety of riding.

Ergonomic seat bag
Comfortable seat bag makes your ride more enjoyable, long distance riding makes you worry-free

Anti-theft Battery
The battery is equipped with a key, which can effectively prevent the battery from being stolen. The advantage of Li-ion battery is slow loss, smallsize and light weight, long range and easy charging.

LED Headlights
Make sure you ride safely in the dark and prevent falls. And we have designed the rear light for you to provide effective hints for the rear car.(Suggestion: Please slow down when riding in the dark)

【750W Brushless Motor & Long-Range Battery】Equipped with a 750W peak brushless motor, this EBKAROCY electric bike provides strong and stable power for daily commuting or recreational rides. The 48V 15Ah lithium battery offers up to 20–30 miles in pure electric mode and up to 68 miles with pedal assist, reducing the need for frequent charging and supporting longer trips.
【Efficient Commuting Performance】This e-bike features 5 levels of pedal assist and a maximum speed of 30MPH, allowing riders to adjust power according to road conditions. The 7-speed gear system ensures smooth shifting and efficient riding whether you’re commuting, exercising, or exploring.
【Durable High-Carbon Steel Frame】The frame is built from high-carbon steel for improved strength, durability, and shock absorption. Despite its solid structure and 20" x 4.0" fat tires for better stability, the bike weighs only 34kg, making it easy to carry and suitable for travel.
【Comfortable and Stable Ride】Designed with dual shock absorbers and wide fat tires, this bike provides a smoother and more comfortable ride on both paved and rough terrain. The large LCD display shows speed, gear, and battery level clearly in all weather conditions, enhancing visibility and safety.
【Easy Setup & Reliable Support】The e-bike arrives 90% pre-assembled for quick and simple setup. Please keep the original packaging in case of return. For assistance, contact the EBKAROCY support team directly. We provide a professional warranty and dedicated after-sales service to ensure customer satisfaction.
